m6502_pair_maps_L16.note: The 6502 study's pair world at L = 16 (tapes A, B of 16 bytes on a ring of 32) on the full NMOS 6502 core: A = X = Y = 0 and P = 0x20 (init.set), PC = 0, the first push on the last byte of B (S from the convention), a per-lane step budget, JAM halting as on the chip (trap 'illegal', as-chip), BRK faithful (it pushes PC + 2 and P and jumps through 0xFFFE/0xFFFF, ring positions 65534 and 65535 mod P); write counts per tape, and the fetch and start maps.

m6502_brkhalt_maps_L16.note: The 6502 study's pair world at L = 16 (tapes A, B of 16 bytes on a ring of 32) on the full NMOS 6502 core: A = X = Y = 0 and P = 0x20 (init.set), PC = 0, the first push on the last byte of B (S from the convention), a per-lane step budget, JAM halting as on the chip (trap 'illegal', as-chip), BRK HALTING: an instruction whose opcode byte is 0x00 halts the lane before it executes (halting.lethal firstUnit 0, the analogue of Stage I's lethal tar); write counts per tape, and the fetch and start maps.
